description: Hand cases for the save.village.* rows (PL.native-village-save-rows) beyond core's village-state corpus: the contract whole, refusal probes for malformed saves and game states, foreign-world and foreign-runtime ownership through ownership and readRuntime, the [invalid-input] boundary, the conversations projection's round trip (rows, records, rows again; through the checked write and read), the conversation clock, the weather block against a weather.create session, and skill.kb.loadJson. Every expectation was computed by core's own functions at the pin (45409ed) by gen-bridge-village-save-cases.mts, kept with the item's loop records; nothing here is a rule of its own.

cases.name: save.village.check: a sound save, an older version, no version, unregistered extensions, an unreadable sky
save.village.write refuses a malformed save or game state as a value, in core order
save.village.read refuses a malformed save as a value
the rows refuse only what core would dereference unread, as [invalid-input]
save.village.ownership: the game's own save, another world's, one naming no world, another runtime's, and the legacy runtime
save.village.readRuntime: a game's Load refuses another world's, then another runtime's, then what the checked read refuses; its own loads
the stamp readers over a stamped and a never-played save
the conversations projection: records read, folded into rows, split back, and folded again changing nothing
the conversations projection through the checked write and read: a save written twice and a load saved again change no row
the conversations projection refuses unreadable records: a value from the read and the write, an error from the rows row
the conversation clock: the wall clock's instant, its bounds, and the round trip back
the clock: timeStateOf carries an hour that rounds to 24 into the next day, and totalHoursOf reads it back
save.village.weather.read: none, unreadable as a whole, readable, and every unreadable member named
save.village.weather.restore and saveState: a saved sky into a director and back out; a game state with no weather restores no sky
skill.kb.loadJson reads any currentState as core does
